subject_need: Make QIF knowledge discovery and application runtime-executable
alternative_solutions: Add explicit discovery-session, evaluation-target, applicability-rule, and review-run models with verifier checks and sample packages.
Extend organizational quality culture into a first-class aggregation artifact grounded in multiple decision patterns.
non_solution_options: Keep runtime behavior implicit in narrative docs and rely on humans to infer how discovery and application should work.
defer_options: Postpone runtime design until a UI or external system integration exists.
stop_options: Do not ship v0.2 if discovery and verdict execution cannot be traced end-to-end in machine-readable artifacts.
